node.title: XR quotient first match occurs at maximum agreement
node.statement: At threshold A, quotient slopes with higher agreement are carried into the existing B_(A+1) term, while every remaining exact quotient slope has maximum agreement exactly A. Any A-point quotient witness for such a slope is the witness codeword's full agreement set. A deterministic scale/codeword order removes cross-threshold and representation duplication; bounding the resulting full-agreement quotient image remains open.
